hook.name: StarbaseHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Starbase STAR/WBNB pool on BNB Chain that collects a 4% tax on each swap, splitting it into burn (1% to dead address), operations (1%), and space fund (2%) portions. Uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to capture tax from both the specified and unspecified sides of each swap.
